en: A muzzle-loading matchlock musket. A domestic copy of the gun that reached Tanegashima.
A copy of the gun brought over from Portugal.

Oak stock cut short to suit Japanese armor.
Fired with the stock held to the cheek.

A Japanese gun developed in Sakai, Senshu.
Built with accuracy in mind.

A Japanese gun developed in Kunitomo, Omi.
Successfully made lighter.
A Japanese gun researched and developed by the Saika group. Built with power in mind.
A pistol. Weak, but light and easy to handle.
As gunpowder improved, the barrel too was built sturdier to match.

A pistol made for use on horseback.
Short range, but high accuracy.

A long-range matchlock.
Fired with the stock against the shoulder.
A gun of several bound barrels. It rotates with each shot to fire the next barrel.
note: Shared by Horse / Nanban / Kunitomo / Senshu / Saika repeaters.

en: A repeater of six bound barrels. Made as a pistol to cut weight, but still heavy.
A bronze cannon. Lacking in both accuracy and power.
A larger version of the bronze cannon, but its power is still lacking.
A Japanese iron cannon developed in Kunitomo, Omi. Highly accurate.
A Japanese iron cannon developed in Sakai, Senshu. Far stronger than bronze cannons.

A cannon firing 4-kanme shot.
Long range, and damages a wide area.
The culmination of Japanese cannons, using all the gunsmithing skill of Kunitomo and Sakai.
A Western cannon, powerful and accurate. Proof of how advanced Western gunsmithing is.

A cannon of tremendous power.
Damages a very wide area.
A sword fitted with all sorts of tricks.
A throwing dart. Short range and weak, but very light.
A hooked claw on an iron chain, swung to attack. Weak.
A cross-shaped shuriken. Very accurate, but useless in close combat.
A dagger-shaped shuriken. Usable in close combat, but inaccurate.
A round pot packed with gunpowder, thrown to explode. Pebbles and such are packed in too.
A sickle and weight joined by an iron chain. Strikes from a distance, and hits hard.
The same type of shuriken the Iga ninja use. Whether it is as powerful is unclear.
The same type of shuriken the Koga ninja use. Whether it is as powerful is unclear.
An improved Flying Claw. Its long, sharp claws can inflict deep wounds.
An improved Hand Dart, thicker and heavier. Its iron chain lets it be thrown and pulled back.
A Koga secret exploding shell, packed with strong gunpowder and bullets.
An Iga secret weapon for near and far. The finest of all ninja fighting weapons.
A Koga ultimate secret. Works as a flash bomb as well as an exploding shell.
An Iga ultimate secret: the most perfected shuriken. Flawless accuracy and power.
Simple armor of worked iron plates joined together. Raises Defense.
A cuirass made sturdier with reinforced iron plates. Raises Defense.

A cuirass made from a single iron plate.
Raises Defense.
A Solid Cuirass improved to deflect bullets and spears. Raises Defense.
A full armor set: cuirass with bracers and leg armor. Raises Defense.
note: Shared by Okegawa-do / Hotoke-do / Nanban-do. [gaps pass 2026-10-28, I-11]

en: A full great-armor set: reinforced body armor with a helmet. Greatly raises Defense.
